terms: Saga of the Buendía family in the mythical town of Macondo.
Literary boom of the 1960s–70s; García Márquez, Vargas Llosa, Cortázar, Fuentes.
Magical realism — realistic narrative with matter-of-fact supernatural elements.
Colombian writer (1927–2014); Nobel Prize 1982; pioneer of magical realism.
Fictional Caribbean town founded by José Arcadio Buendía — microcosm of Latin America.
'Muchos años después... el coronel Aureliano Buendía había de recordar' — famous opening.
